scoping_law.spec_mandate: N14: 'CAST-32A thrash: 16 adversarial threads vs sequencer; bounded max latency, zero deadlock'
scoping_law.delivered: full spec shape delivered: 16 real adversarial threads (8x 8 MiB = 2x-L2 LCG-strided mutating eviction + 8x adjacent-cacheline atomic spinners doing cross-line fetch_add) concurrent with the consensus pipeline (CasRing MPMC 4x4 + FIFO sequencer) executing 1,000,000 sequencer-ticked transitions per run. The spec's <=4.5 ns per-transition figure is a deterministic single-core evidence-class target and is NOT asserted under 16-thread contention — the real measured max is reported (honest-scoping law, same treatment as N07). The asserted bounds are the generous liveness ceiling (600 s watchdog = zero-deadlock court; 1 s per single transition = stall ceiling).
scoping_law.mapping: spec 'bounded max latency' -> measured max reported + generous stall ceiling asserted (4.5 ns target NOT claimed under contention); spec 'zero deadlock' -> 600 s recv_timeout watchdog, typed DEADLOCK finding; spec '16 adversarial threads' -> delivered exactly 16 (8 eviction + 8 spinners)

court.design: per run: (a) 16 adversarial threads launched first (storm covers the whole commit phase); (b) 4 producers each execute 250,000 transitions — one transition = shared Mutex<Sequence> tick -> CasRing claim (spin on RingFull) -> commit of uniquely-tagged word p*250k+i, per-transition Instant timing on all 1M; (c) 4 consumers drain until the global count reaches 1M; (d) watchdog thread + mpsc recv_timeout(600 s) turns a hang into a typed DEADLOCK failure; (e) conservation: drained stream sorted and checked against the disjoint-range law (word p*250k+i at exactly one sorted index) — zero loss, zero duplication, zero double-claim; (f) order-sensitive FNV-1a checksum over the sorted stream = run-invariant multiset identity for the 3-run determinism leg. Adversaries joined after producers complete; consumers finish under storm through the drain phase.

adversaries.eviction: 8 threads, each streaming its own 8 MiB buffer (2x host L2 of 4 MiB, hw.l2cachesize) with full-period LCG x = x*6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407, index = (x>>24) % n, mutating writes (lines dirtied and rewritten), distinct seed per thread
adversaries.atomic_spin: 8 threads, one AtomicU64 per thread on 8 CONSECUTIVE unpadded cachelines (#[repr(align(64))] array), each thread fetch_add on its own line plus a read-modify-write on the ADJACENT line, forcing MESI ownership bounce between neighboring lines and the stop flag

court.payload_domain: words p*250_000+i <= ~3.25e6, far from the CasRing reserved sentinels u64::MAX / u64::MAX-1 (documented domain contract)
